data.name: Tour.Reset.Done
data.value: Each screen will replay its tour on your next visit.

data.name: Tour.home.welcome.Text
data.value: Here is where everything is, in one minute. Arrow keys move back and forth, Esc closes this tour.

data.name: Tour.home.nav.Text
data.value: Quotes, invoices, customers, catalogue, FEC: everything starts here. On a phone, the bottom tabs hold the essentials and "More" the rest.

data.name: Tour.home.search.Text
data.value: Type a document number, a customer name or an action ("new quote Dupont"). Text templates can be inserted from here too.

data.name: Tour.home.starter.Text
data.value: This list ticks itself as you work. Hide it whenever you like.

data.name: Tour.home.appearance.Text
data.value: Light, dark, slate or high contrast, and a Comfort density for touch or Expert for the keyboard.

data.name: Tour.home.help.Text
data.value: Every screen has its own tour, played on your first visit. This button replays it at any time.

data.name: Tour.quotes.list.Text
data.value: Drafts, sent, accepted or invoiced quotes. Click one to open it.

data.name: Tour.quotes.filters.Text
data.value: F3 puts the cursor in the search box: number, customer or subject. The status narrows the list.

data.name: Tour.quotes.new.Text
data.value: The quote is saved as a draft while you type, even offline on a desktop.

data.name: Tour.quote-editor.customer.Text
data.value: F4 opens the customer list. Once chosen, Lettra suggests the items they usually buy.

data.name: Tour.quote-editor.lines.Text
data.value: Enter moves to the next cell, Insert adds a line, Ctrl+Delete removes it. Totals update as you type.

data.name: Tour.quote-editor.keys.Text
data.value: On the reference, F4 opens the catalogue; on the description, the wordings already used; on unit and VAT, their lists. The keys are also here for touch.

data.name: Tour.quote-editor.quick.Text
data.value: In quantity, "3h" means 3 hours, "1.5d" a day and a half, "2x45" does the maths. Price accepts "2x45" too.

data.name: Tour.quote-editor.templates.Text
data.value: Type "/" in a free-text field to insert a ready-made notice or condition. Capitals and spaces are tidied when you leave the field.

data.name: Tour.quote-editor.compliance.Text
data.value: Mandatory notices are checked continuously. Clicking a finding moves the cursor to the line at fault.

data.name: Tour.quote-editor.why.Text
data.value: If the firm has enabled the assistant, "Why?" explains the rule. It is never on by default.

data.name: Tour.quote-editor.validate.Text
data.value: Ctrl+Enter numbers and locks the quote once the check is green. Then: accepted, down payment, final invoice.

data.name: Tour.invoices.list.Text
data.value: The file's invoices, down payments and credit notes, with their issue status.

data.name: Tour.invoices.filters.Text
data.value: By document type and status; F3 to search a number or customer.

data.name: Tour.invoices.new.Text
data.value: Start from scratch here, or from an accepted quote to reuse its lines.

data.name: Tour.invoice-editor.customer.Text
data.value: F4 opens the list. Lettra then suggests their usual items and latest payment terms.

data.name: Tour.invoice-editor.terms.Text
data.value: Type "/" to pick a ready-made wording (30 days end of month, on receipt…).

data.name: Tour.invoice-editor.lines.Text
data.value: Same grid as quotes: F4 on each column, quick entry "3h" or "2x45".

data.name: Tour.invoice-editor.compliance.Text
data.value: An incomplete invoice cannot be validated: the list says what is missing.

data.name: Tour.invoice-editor.validate.Text
data.value: Validating numbers the invoice; issuing sends it to the platform. An issued invoice cannot change, it is corrected by a credit note.

data.name: Tour.invoice-editor.einvoice.Text
data.value: PDF, Factur-X or UBL, generated on the device.

data.name: Tour.customers.lookup.Text
data.value: Type a name or SIREN: the form fills itself from the company directory.

data.name: Tour.customers.address.Text
data.value: Type the postcode and the city is suggested. It works the other way round too.

data.name: Tour.customers.list.Text
data.value: They are then used in quotes, invoices and the Ctrl+K search.

data.name: Tour.catalog.list.Text
data.value: Your services and products, with price, unit and VAT, copied onto each line.

data.name: Tour.catalog.search.Text
data.value: F3 puts the cursor in the search box.

data.name: Tour.catalog.new.Text
data.value: Insert opens a blank record. To type many at once, “Grid entry” is still there (F4 on unit and VAT).

data.name: Tour.fec.period.Text
data.value: Choose the financial year or period to export.

data.name: Tour.fec.export.Text
data.value: The accounting entries file is produced and checked against article A47 A-1 of the LPF.

data.name: Tour.fec.report.Text
data.value: Debit and credit balance, mandatory fields: every gap is listed.

data.name: Tour.sync.state.Text
data.value: On the desktop you work offline; Lettra syncs with the firm when you agree.

data.name: Tour.sync.pending.Text
data.value: Documents created offline, ready to go.

data.name: Tour.sync.run.Text
data.value: One click sends and receives; a conflict is shown field by field.

data.name: Tour.alerts.list.Text
data.value: Open an alert to see its likely cause and what was already tried.

data.name: Tour.alerts.detail.Text
data.value: Acknowledge, then close with a reason: everything is logged.

data.name: Tour.assistant.intro.Text
data.value: It explains and drafts. It never validates, issues or sends anything itself.

data.name: Tour.assistant.feature.Text
data.value: Only the features your firm enabled appear here.

data.name: Tour.assistant.ask.Text
data.value: It only reads the document open on screen.

data.name: Tour.assistant.limits.Text
data.value: The engine runs in the firm's cell or on the device, never at a third party without the firm's consent.

data.name: Starter.invoice
data.value: Turn a quote into an invoice
